package postgres

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/url"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
	dialogclient "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/dialog"
	practiceclient "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/practice"
	dialogevents "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/message/nats"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/studentcontext"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/teacherdialog"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

var errT13BeforeAppend = errors.New("synthetic fault after assistance commit before Dialog append")
var errT13LostAppend = errors.New("synthetic response loss after actual Dialog append commit")

type t13CutAppender struct {
	Inner repository.DialogTeacherResponseAppender
	Cut   string
	Calls int
}

func (a *t13CutAppender) AppendTeacherResponse(ctx context.Context, r domain.DialogTeacherRequest, key, body string) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	a.Calls++
	if a.Cut == "before" {
		a.Cut = ""
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, errT13BeforeAppend
	}
	result, e := a.Inner.AppendTeacherResponse(ctx, r, key, body)
	if e == nil && a.Cut == "after" {
		a.Cut = ""
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, errT13LostAppend
	}
	return result, e
}

type t13Clock struct{ Time time.Time }

func (c *t13Clock) Now() time.Time { return c.Time }

type t13IDs struct{}

func (t13IDs) NewID() string { return uuid.NewString() }

type t13NoTeacher struct{}

func (t13NoTeacher) Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error) {
	return domain.PersonalTeacher{}, errors.New("unexpected generation identity read")
}

type t13NoSoul struct{}

func (t13NoSoul) Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherSoul, error) {
	return domain.TeacherSoul{}, errors.New("unexpected generation soul read")
}

type t13NoContext struct{}

func (t13NoContext) Execute(context.Context, studentcontext.BuildInput) (domain.StudentContext, error) {
	return domain.StudentContext{}, errors.New("unexpected generation context read")
}

type t13NoPrompt struct{}

func (t13NoPrompt) Build(context.Context, domain.DialogRequestContext, string, time.Time) (domain.TeacherPromptDialogContext, error) {
	return domain.TeacherPromptDialogContext{}, errors.New("unexpected generation prompt build")
}

type t13NoPlan struct{}

func (t13NoPlan) Plan(domain.PersonalTeacher, domain.DialogTeacherRequest, domain.StudentContext, domain.DialogRequestContext, []domain.TeacherDecision) (domain.TeacherTeachingPlan, error) {
	return domain.TeacherTeachingPlan{}, errors.New("unexpected generation plan")
}

type t13NoGenerator struct{ Calls int }

func (g *t13NoGenerator) Generate(context.Context, domain.TeacherGenerationRequest) (domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse, error) {
	g.Calls++
	return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, errors.New("unexpected live generation")
}
func (g *t13NoGenerator) Replay(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse, error) {
	g.Calls++
	return domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{}, errors.New("unexpected generation replay")
}

type t13RuntimeState struct {
	SubmissionAnchors int    `json:"synthetic_validating_submission_anchor_count"`
	RunAnchors        int    `json:"synthetic_pending_run_anchor_count"`
	OfficialOutcomes  int    `json:"official_outcome_count"`
	Evidence          int    `json:"evidence_outbox_count"`
	StudentID         string `json:"student_id"`
	InstanceID        string `json:"task_instance_id"`
	Status            string `json:"status"`
	Version           int64  `json:"version"`
	Count             int    `json:"receipt_count"`
	Hints             int    `json:"hints_used"`
	Receipts          []struct {
		UsageID    string    `json:"usage_id"`
		StudentID  string    `json:"student_id"`
		InstanceID string    `json:"task_instance_id"`
		StepID     string    `json:"step_id"`
		Kind       string    `json:"kind"`
		Hint       int       `json:"hint_level"`
		Policy     string    `json:"policy_version"`
		Time       time.Time `json:"occurred_at"`
	} `json:"receipts"`
}
type t13DialogState struct {
	Count   int `json:"assistant_count"`
	Replies []struct {
		ID   string `json:"message_id"`
		Key  string `json:"append_key"`
		Hash string `json:"body_sha256"`
	} `json:"replies"`
}

// Root starts both real PG providers before this opt-in test. Generation is a
// declared bounded pre-generated fixture staged using actual SaveGenerated:
// no model/provider/LLM execution is claimed. Recovery uses production Worker,
// Claim/lease recovery, repository objects and real Practice/Dialog clients.
func TestT13AssistanceDialogRecovery(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("T13_COMPOSED") != "true" {
		t.Skip("owned T13 composed providers gate absent")
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 90*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	var runtime struct {
		URL        string `json:"url"`
		StudentID  string `json:"student_id"`
		InstanceID string `json:"task_instance_id"`
		ActionID   string `json:"learning_action_id"`
		StepID     string `json:"step_id"`
	}
	var dialog struct {
		URL       string          `json:"url"`
		TeacherID string          `json:"personal_teacher_id"`
		Envelope  json.RawMessage `json:"event_payload"`
	}
	t13ReadMetadata(t, os.Getenv("T13_RUNTIME_READY_FILE"), &runtime)
	t13ReadMetadata(t, os.Getenv("T13_DIALOG_READY_FILE"), &dialog)
	internal, teacher, dialogToken := os.Getenv("T13_RUNTIME_TOKEN"), os.Getenv("T13_TEACHER_TOKEN"), os.Getenv("T13_DIALOG_TOKEN")
	if internal == "" || teacher == "" || internal == teacher || dialogToken == "" || os.Getenv("T13_RECOVERY_RESULT_FILE") == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing owned composed fixture configuration")
	}
	for _, base := range []string{runtime.URL, dialog.URL} {
		u, e := url.Parse(base)
		if e != nil || u.Scheme != "http" || u.Hostname() != "127.0.0.1" {
			t.Fatal("providers must use owned loopback HTTP")
		}
	}
	request, e := dialogevents.DecodeDialogTeacherRequested(dialog.Envelope)
	if e != nil || request.StudentID != runtime.StudentID || request.PersonalTeacherID != dialog.TeacherID || request.ContextID != runtime.InstanceID || request.LearningActionID != runtime.ActionID || request.ContextType != domain.LearningContextPracticeTask {
		t.Fatal("actual Dialog event identities differ from Runtime fixture")
	}
	pool := teacherDecisionIntegrationPool(t)
	now := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
	_, e = pool.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO personal_teacher(id,student_id,teacher_profile_id,language,communication_style,pedagogy_profile,hint_policy,intervention_mode,version,created_at,updated_at) VALUES($1,$2,'t13-synthetic','en','bounded','adaptive','scaffold','manual',1,$3,$3)`, dialog.TeacherID, runtime.StudentID, now)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal("synthetic Teacher identity seed failed")
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		c := context.Background()
		for _, query := range []string{`DELETE FROM teacher_dialog_job WHERE personal_teacher_id=$1`, `DELETE FROM teacher_outbox WHERE student_id IN (SELECT student_id FROM personal_teacher WHERE id=$1)`, `DELETE FROM teacher_decision WHERE personal_teacher_id=$1`, `DELETE FROM personal_teacher WHERE id=$1`} {
			if _, err := pool.Exec(c, query, dialog.TeacherID); err != nil {
				t.Error("owned Teacher cleanup failed")
			}
		}
	})
	jobs := TeacherDialogJobRepository{Pool: pool}
	job, e := domain.NewTeacherDialogJob(request, now)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal("actual event job normalization failed")
	}
	accepted, e := jobs.Accept(ctx, job)
	if e != nil || !accepted {
		t.Fatal("actual job intake failed")
	}
	lease := 2 * time.Second
	claimed, ok, e := jobs.Claim(ctx, repository.TeacherDialogClaim{ClaimToken: uuid.NewString(), WorkerID: "t13-stage", Now: now, LockedUntil: now.Add(lease)})
	if e != nil || !ok || claimed.Request.EventID != request.EventID {
		t.Fatal("actual staging claim failed")
	}
	level := 2
	decision, e := domain.NewTeacherDecision(domain.TeacherDecision{ID: uuid.NewString(), PersonalTeacherID: dialog.TeacherID, StudentID: runtime.StudentID, CorrelationID: runtime.ActionID, CausationID: request.EventID, LearningActionID: runtime.ActionID, TeachingMode: domain.TeachingModePractice, ContextType: domain.LearningContextPracticeTask, ContextID: runtime.InstanceID, PracticeStepID: runtime.StepID, PedagogyMethod: "progressive-hint", PedagogyVersion: "v1", PedagogyStage: domain.PedagogyStage("orient"), Strategy: "scaffolding", Action: domain.TeacherActionGiveHint, HintLevel: &level, ReasonCode: "t13_synthetic", ReasonSummary: "Bounded pregenerated fixture", PolicyVersion: "teacher-dialog-policy-v1", CreatedAt: now})
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal("bounded fixture decision invalid")
	}
	event, e := domain.NewIntegrationEvent(uuid.NewString(), domain.SubjectTeacherDecisionRecorded, decision.CorrelationID, decision.CausationID, decision.StudentID, now, domain.TeacherDecisionRecordedSchemaVersion, decision)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal("fixture decision event invalid")
	}
	// Private fixture text stays in process/owned DB and is exported as hash only.
	body := "Check the boundary condition for the smallest input before changing the implementation."
	digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(body))
	bodyHash := hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
	if e = jobs.SaveGenerated(ctx, request.EventID, claimed.ClaimToken, decision, event, body, uuid.NewString(), now); e != nil {
		t.Fatal("actual SaveGenerated transaction failed")
	}
	generator := &t13NoGenerator{}
	clock := &t13Clock{Time: now.Add(lease + time.Second)}
	httpClient := &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
	newWorker := func(cut string) (teacherdialog.Worker, *t13CutAppender) {
		dc := dialogclient.Client{BaseURL: dialog.URL, InternalToken: dialogToken, HTTPClient: httpClient}
		appender := &t13CutAppender{Inner: dc, Cut: cut}
		return teacherdialog.Worker{Jobs: TeacherDialogJobRepository{Pool: pool}, Teachers: t13NoTeacher{}, Souls: t13NoSoul{}, StudentContext: t13NoContext{}, PromptContext: t13NoPrompt{}, DialogReader: dc, DialogAppender: appender, Decisions: TeacherDecisionRepository{Pool: pool}, Pedagogy: t13NoPlan{}, Generator: generator, PracticeAssistance: practiceclient.Client{BaseURL: runtime.URL, InternalToken: teacher, HTTPClient: httpClient}, IDs: t13IDs{}, Clock: clock, WorkerID: "t13-reconstructed-" + uuid.NewString(), LeaseTTL: 30 * time.Second, LeaseRenewInterval: 5 * time.Second, MaxAttempts: 6, RetryBaseDelay: time.Millisecond, RetryMaxDelay: time.Second}, appender
	}
	call := func(method, path, token string, input any, want int, output any) {
		t.Helper()
		raw, e := json.Marshal(input)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal("fixture command encode failed")
		}
		req, e := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, method, path, bytes.NewReader(raw))
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal("fixture HTTP command invalid")
		}
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
		req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		resp, e := httpClient.Do(req)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal("fixture HTTP provider unavailable")
		}
		defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()
		if resp.StatusCode != want {
			t.Fatalf("actual provider status=%d want=%d", resp.StatusCode, want)
		}
		if output != nil {
			if json.NewDecoder(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 1<<20)).Decode(output) != nil {
				t.Fatal("safe provider state decode failed")
			}
		}
	}
	readRuntime := func() t13RuntimeState {
		var s t13RuntimeState
		call(http.MethodGet, runtime.URL+"/__t13/inspect", internal, nil, 200, &s)
		return s
	}
	readDialog := func() t13DialogState {
		var s t13DialogState
		call(http.MethodGet, dialog.URL+"/__t13/inspect", dialogToken, nil, 200, &s)
		return s
	}
	assertPending := func(wantStatus string) {
		t.Helper()
		var status, storedBody, storedDecision string
		if pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT status,coalesce(response_body,''),coalesce(decision_id::text,'') FROM teacher_dialog_job WHERE event_id=$1`, request.EventID).Scan(&status, &storedBody, &storedDecision) != nil || status != wantStatus || storedBody != body || storedDecision != decision.ID {
			t.Fatal("durable private pending response/decision changed")
		}
	}
	worker, cut := newWorker("before")
	processed, e := worker.ProcessNext(ctx)
	if !processed || !errors.Is(e, errT13BeforeAppend) || cut.Calls != 1 {
		t.Fatal("fault was not reached after actual assistance commit")
	}
	assertPending("delivery_pending")
	first := readRuntime()
	if first.Count != 1 || first.Hints != 1 || len(first.Receipts) != 1 || first.Receipts[0].UsageID != decision.ID || first.Receipts[0].StepID != runtime.StepID || first.Receipts[0].Time.IsZero() {
		t.Fatal("actual Runtime first assistance fact/counter missing")
	}
	if readDialog().Count != 0 {
		t.Fatal("before-append fault created a Dialog response")
	}
	proofs := map[string]any{"classification": "actual Teacher PG SaveGenerated/Worker/Claim + production Practice HTTP + Runtime usecase/PG + registered Dialog private HTTP/usecase/PG; synthetic pregenerated bounded response and lifecycle transitions; no LLM/Start/completion proof", "source_event_id": request.EventID, "decision_usage_id": decision.ID, "body_sha256": bodyHash, "generator_calls": 0, "first_receipt_time": first.Receipts[0].Time, "before_append_cut_reached": true, "staging_expired_lease_reclaimed": true}
	assistance := func(usage, student, step, kind string, hint int) map[string]any {
		return map[string]any{"usage_id": usage, "student_id": student, "assistance": map[string]any{"schema": "practice-task-assistance-usage.v1", "step_id": step, "kind": kind, "hint_level": hint}}
	}
	assistanceURL := runtime.URL + "/internal/task-instances/" + runtime.InstanceID + "/teacher-assistance"
	exact := assistance(decision.ID, runtime.StudentID, runtime.StepID, "HINT", level)
	// A separate HTTP request advances the server clock while preserving stable
	// command identity. UC-only RED overlays may already have corrected PG replay.
	time.Sleep(20 * time.Millisecond)
	reqRaw, _ := json.Marshal(exact)
	req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, assistanceURL, bytes.NewReader(reqRaw))
	req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", teacher)
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	resp, e := httpClient.Do(req)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal("time-advance replay provider unavailable")
	}
	timeReplayStatus := resp.StatusCode
	_ = resp.Body.Close()
	proofs["time_advance_replay_http_status"] = timeReplayStatus
	baseline := os.Getenv("T13_BASELINE_RED") == "true"
	if !baseline && timeReplayStatus != 200 {
		t.Fatal("exact time-advance assistance replay rejected")
	}
	call(http.MethodPost, assistanceURL, internal, exact, 401, nil)
	call(http.MethodPost, assistanceURL, "synthetic-wrong-token", exact, 401, nil)
	call(http.MethodPost, assistanceURL, teacher, assistance(decision.ID, uuid.NewString(), runtime.StepID, "HINT", level), 404, nil)
	call(http.MethodPost, assistanceURL, teacher, assistance(decision.ID, runtime.StudentID, runtime.StepID, "HINT", level+1), 409, nil)
	wrongStepStatus := 409
	if baseline {
		wrongStepStatus = 404
	} // Original UC checks unknown step before receipt lookup.
	call(http.MethodPost, assistanceURL, teacher, assistance(decision.ID, runtime.StudentID, uuid.NewString(), "HINT", level), wrongStepStatus, nil)
	call(http.MethodPost, assistanceURL, teacher, assistance(decision.ID, runtime.StudentID, runtime.StepID, "TEACHER_EXPLANATION", 0), 409, nil)
	negatives := readRuntime()
	if negatives.Count != 1 || negatives.Hints != 1 || negatives.Version != first.Version || !negatives.Receipts[0].Time.Equal(first.Receipts[0].Time) {
		t.Fatal("replay/negative request mutated facts or original time")
	}
	proofs["runtime_identity_payload_token_negative_checks"] = true
	call(http.MethodPost, runtime.URL+"/__t13/control", teacher, map[string]any{"action": "lifecycle", "status": "IN_REVIEW"}, 401, nil)
	var review t13RuntimeState
	call(http.MethodPost, runtime.URL+"/__t13/control", internal, map[string]any{"action": "lifecycle", "status": "IN_REVIEW"}, 200, &review)
	if review.StudentID != runtime.StudentID || review.Status != "IN_REVIEW" {
		t.Fatal("synthetic lifecycle transition changed owner")
	}
	call(http.MethodPost, assistanceURL, teacher, assistance(uuid.NewString(), runtime.StudentID, runtime.StepID, "HINT", level), 409, nil)
	clock.Time = clock.Time.Add(time.Second)
	worker, cut = newWorker("after")
	processed, e = worker.ProcessNext(ctx)
	if baseline {
		if !processed || !errors.Is(e, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable) || cut.Calls != 0 || readDialog().Count != 0 {
			t.Fatal("RED did not reproduce actual lifecycle business error before append")
		}
		assertPending("delivery_pending")
		retained := readRuntime()
		if retained.Count != 1 || retained.Hints != 1 || !retained.Receipts[0].Time.Equal(first.Receipts[0].Time) {
			t.Fatal("RED mutated accepted assistance")
		}
		proofs["baseline_red_lifecycle_conflict"] = true
		proofs["runtime_receipt_count"] = retained.Count
		proofs["runtime_hints_used"] = retained.Hints
		proofs["dialog_assistant_count"] = 0
		proofs["private_pending_body_retained"] = true
		t13RecoveryWrite(t, proofs)
		t.Error("RED: actual stored-response Worker recovery is rejected by original Runtime lifecycle guard after accepted assistance; Dialog append never reached")
		return
	}
	if !processed || !errors.Is(e, errT13LostAppend) || cut.Calls != 1 {
		t.Fatal("real append commit / synthetic response-loss cut not reached")
	}
	assertPending("delivery_pending")
	committed := readDialog()
	if committed.Count != 1 || len(committed.Replies) != 1 || committed.Replies[0].Key != request.EventID || committed.Replies[0].Hash != bodyHash {
		t.Fatal("actual Dialog append is not exactly correlated")
	}
	afterReview := readRuntime()
	if afterReview.Version != review.Version || afterReview.Count != 1 || afterReview.Hints != 1 || !afterReview.Receipts[0].Time.Equal(first.Receipts[0].Time) {
		t.Fatal("review replay mutated stable assistance")
	}
	var completed t13RuntimeState
	call(http.MethodPost, runtime.URL+"/__t13/control", internal, map[string]any{"action": "lifecycle", "status": "COMPLETED"}, 200, &completed)
	clock.Time = clock.Time.Add(time.Second)
	worker, _ = newWorker("")
	processed, e = worker.ProcessNext(ctx)
	if e != nil || !processed {
		t.Fatal("actual reconstructed delivery recovery failed")
	}
	final := readRuntime()
	finalDialog := readDialog()
	if final.SubmissionAnchors != 1 || final.RunAnchors != 1 || final.OfficialOutcomes != 0 || final.Evidence != 0 || final.Version != completed.Version || final.Count != 1 || final.Hints != 1 || final.StudentID != runtime.StudentID || !final.Receipts[0].Time.Equal(first.Receipts[0].Time) || finalDialog.Count != 1 || finalDialog.Replies[0].ID != committed.Replies[0].ID || generator.Calls != 0 {
		t.Fatal("recovery duplicated a fact/response, changed timestamp/owner, or regenerated")
	}
	var status, remaining, delivered string
	var decisions, outboxCount int
	if pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT status,coalesce(response_body,''),coalesce(delivered_message_id::text,'') FROM teacher_dialog_job WHERE event_id=$1`, request.EventID).Scan(&status, &remaining, &delivered) != nil || status != "delivered" || remaining != "" || delivered != committed.Replies[0].ID {
		t.Fatal("verified append did not clear private response and finish delivery")
	}
	if pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM teacher_decision WHERE id=$1),(SELECT count(*) FROM teacher_outbox WHERE causation_id=$2 AND subject='teacher.decision.recorded')`, decision.ID, request.EventID).Scan(&decisions, &outboxCount) != nil || decisions != 1 || outboxCount != 1 {
		t.Fatal("SaveGenerated decision/outbox is not singular")
	}
	// Production Dialog HTTP rejects changed payload under the original append key.
	appendURL := dialog.URL + "/internal/v1/teacher-dialog/" + request.DialogID + "/message"
	call(http.MethodPost, appendURL, "synthetic-wrong-token", map[string]any{"personal_teacher_id": dialog.TeacherID, "source_message_id": request.SourceMessageID, "idempotency_key": request.EventID, "body": body}, 401, nil)
	call(http.MethodPost, appendURL, dialogToken, map[string]any{"personal_teacher_id": dialog.TeacherID, "source_message_id": request.SourceMessageID, "idempotency_key": request.EventID, "body": body + " changed"}, 409, nil)
	call(http.MethodPost, appendURL, dialogToken, map[string]any{"personal_teacher_id": uuid.NewString(), "source_message_id": request.SourceMessageID, "idempotency_key": uuid.NewString(), "body": body}, 403, nil)
	if readDialog().Count != 1 {
		t.Fatal("Dialog negative requests created responses")
	}
	call(http.MethodPost, assistanceURL, teacher, assistance(uuid.NewString(), runtime.StudentID, runtime.StepID, "HINT", level), 409, nil)
	proofs["synthetic_validating_submission_anchor_count"] = final.SubmissionAnchors
	proofs["synthetic_pending_run_anchor_count"] = final.RunAnchors
	proofs["official_outcome_count"] = final.OfficialOutcomes
	proofs["evidence_outbox_count"] = final.Evidence
	proofs["runtime_receipt_count"] = final.Count
	proofs["runtime_hints_used"] = final.Hints
	proofs["stable_receipt_time"] = true
	proofs["dialog_assistant_count"] = finalDialog.Count
	proofs["dialog_response_id"] = delivered
	proofs["dialog_append_key"] = request.EventID
	proofs["decision_count"] = decisions
	proofs["decision_outbox_count"] = outboxCount
	proofs["private_pending_body_cleared_after_verified_append"] = true
	proofs["after_append_response_loss_recovered"] = true
	proofs["generator_calls"] = generator.Calls
	proofs["fresh_fact_after_review_completed_rejected"] = true
	proofs["dialog_token_payload_owner_negative_checks"] = true
	t13RecoveryWrite(t, proofs)
}
func t13ReadMetadata(t *testing.T, path string, value any) {
	t.Helper()
	raw, e := os.ReadFile(path)
	if e != nil || json.Unmarshal(raw, value) != nil {
		t.Fatal("owned safe provider metadata missing")
	}
}
func t13RecoveryWrite(t *testing.T, value any) {
	t.Helper()
	raw, e := json.MarshalIndent(value, "", "  ")
	path := os.Getenv("T13_RECOVERY_RESULT_FILE")
	if e != nil || os.WriteFile(path+".tmp", append(raw, '\n'), 0600) != nil || os.Rename(path+".tmp", path) != nil {
		t.Fatal("safe recovery proof export failed")
	}
}
